title: Remove Consecutive Duplicates
statement:
Given a string S of lowercase English letters, remove all consecutive duplicate characters, keeping only the first occurrence of each run.

For example, "aaabbbcc" becomes "abc".
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: A single line: S with consecutive duplicate characters removed.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^5
S contains only lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: Three a's collapse to one, three b's to one, two c's to one.
No consecutive duplicates, so the string is unchanged.

starterCode.python:
s = input().strip()
